question: ______ became the first Indian to win the under-18 title in the Orange Bowl tournament in 2008.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Yuki Bhambri.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yuki Bhambri became the first Indian to win the under-18 title in the Orange Bowl tournament in 2008.**
 
• Yuki Bhambri is a professional tennis player from India.
 
• He is a** former junior no.1 and winner of the 2009 Australian Open Junior single Championship.**
 
• He is the first Indian to win the junior Australian Open title and the fourth Indian in history to capture a junior singles title at a Grand Slam championship.
 
• He represented India in the** Davis Cup.**
 
• **Yuki also got direct entry into the 2018 Wimbledon Championships for the first time**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leander Paes:**

 
 
• He is a professional tennis player in India.
 
• He was honoured with the **Padma Shri award in 2001.**
 
• He is the sports ambassador of the Haryana state.
 
 
 
• **Rohan Bopanna:**
 
 
• He is an Indian professional tennis player.
 
• **His singles career-high ranking was World No. 213 in 2007 and his career-high ranking in doubles was World No. 3 on 22 July 2013.**
